title: Matte Black Bottle on Marble
tests: Produces a finished product image from text while honoring the stated material, setting and lighting.

judge.summary: A clean product photo shows a fully visible matte black water bottle on veined white marble with soft lighting and gentle shadows.

must_haves.item: A water bottle is the main subject and is fully visible.
must_haves.why: The bottle is centered and clearly visible from its cap to its base, with space around it.

must_haves.item: The bottle has a matte black finish rather than a glossy or metallic finish.
must_haves.why: The black body has subdued, broad highlights without sharp reflections or a metallic appearance.

must_haves.item: The bottle stands on a visibly veined marble surface.
must_haves.why: The white surface beneath the bottle has clearly visible gray marble veining.

must_haves.item: Lighting is soft, with gentle shadows rather than harsh glare.
must_haves.why: Diffused highlights and a soft shadow beside the base create gentle lighting without harsh glare.
